meta.name: antinet-four-color-cards
meta.description: 财务和投资分析师、律师助理与法律助手在撰写金融研报或分析法律文档时，必用此技能！基于解析文档一键生成事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡与行动红卡。自动完成深度剖析与风险排查，产出100%可溯源的结构化四色报告，让复杂分析高效且严谨。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解析文档,生成四色分析卡,让复杂金融与法律分析高效严谨
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要快速梳理金融研报或法律文档中的事实与风险
copy.tagline_en: Turn complex documents into structured four-color analysis reports for finance and law.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to break down financial reports or legal documents into key facts and risks.

howto.what: 把解析后的结构化文档转成四色卡片:蓝卡记事实、绿卡作解释、黄卡列风险、红卡给行动,每张卡片都附来源片段以便溯源。
howto.when: 当你撰写金融研报或分析法律文档、需要把文档拆成四色卡片时触发,由通政司 Worker 主调用。

say.text: 跑 extract 阶段,把这些文档生成事实蓝卡
跑 review 阶段,复核黄卡的过度声明与解释
跑 propose 阶段,补全行动红卡建议

howto.what_en: Turns a parsed structured document into four cards: blue (facts), green (explanations), yellow (risks), red (actions), each citing its source snippets for traceability.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you write a financial research report or analyze a legal document and need it split into four-color cards; called mainly by the Tongzhengsi worker.

say_en.text: Run the extract stage to turn these documents into fact blue cards
Run the review stage to check yellow-card overstatement
Run the propose stage to complete the action red cards
